rationale.complete: Round 1 with per-period verdicts and the confirmatory NE15 run are done; robustness, rivals (Hawkes, shared artifacts) and per-period re-analysis of the pooled tests remain.
rationale.faithfulness: The talk-channel block model beats the shared-schedule and room-label nulls, and the primary holdout DiD passed, but the pooled primary test failed, J_in rose instead of staying fixed, the post-split window was not blind, and the entropy-production half is untestable.
rationale.usefulness: "Rooms decouple chat but not work" is a validated design rule and a cheap monitor, but the chat half is nearly implied by the visibility scaffold and rests on one cut.

one_line: Rooms cut chat coupling (holdout DiD passed; verdict inconclusive); work isn't room-bound; EP unmeasurable

v2.claim: Rooms cut chat coupling between agents
v2.rater: coordinator first pass (from integrated reports); independent rater pending
